Q: Why are the "Last Run" and "Next Run" the same date? A:

this is actually normal in Airflow. What’s happening is that Airflow doesn’t run a DAG at the start_date, it runs it after the full schedule interval has finished. Since this DAG is @daily, Airflow waits for the whole day to pass before creating the first run. Because that interval hasn’t completed yet, no run has actually happened — so Airflow shows the same logical date for both Last Run and Next Run. Basically, it’s saying “this is the first run I’m planning, but it hasn’t happened yet.” Once the interval completes, you’ll see Last Run move forward and Next Run advance to the next day.

Q: How to calculate total of values based on if other variables are similar? A:

Another alternative with using a query with SQL.

Sub Test()
    Dim myDB As String, adoCon As Object, strSQL As String, RS As Object
    
    Const adOpenDynamic = 1
    Const adLockOptimistic = 3
    
    myDB = ThisWorkbook.FullName
    
    Set adoCon = CreateObject("ADODB.Connection")
    Set RS = CreateObject("ADODB.RecordSet")
    
    adoCon.Open "Provider=Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0;Data Source=" & myDB & ";Extended Properties=""Excel 12.0;HDR=Yes"""
    
    strSQL = "Select Header1, Sum(Header2) From [Sheet1$] Group By Header1 "
        
    RS.Open Source:=strSQL, ActiveConnection:=adoCon, CursorType:=adOpenDynamic, LockType:=adLockOptimistic
    
    Range("H1:I" & Rows.Count) = ""
    Range("H1:I1") = Array("Header1", "Header2")
    Range("H2").CopyFromRecordset RS
    
    Set RS = Nothing
    Set adoCon = Nothing
End Sub

Q: WEKA 3.8.4 is very slow to Start on my Windows 10 PC A:

For anyone facing this isse, I was able to solve this by changing java version and launching it from terminal using an older jdk.

"C:\Program Files\Java\jre1.8.0_181\bin\java.exe" -jar "C:\Program Files\Weka-3-9\weka.jar"

I was by default using jdk-24 so this cmd above let me use older version

Q: Task :app:uploadCrashlyticsMappingFileRelease FAILED Expected file collection to contain exactly one file, however, it contains no files A:

If you are using DPI bypass tools, you might get that error. I was using Zapret, and disabling it while getting the build fixed the issue

Q: npm install does not work in my angular project A:

You have some missing modules in node_modules folder. try to install with auto-install.

  • first install the global-cli by cmd npm install -g auto-install
  • then run auto-install in the directory you are working in.

Q: how to solve /bin/sh: protoc: command not found? A:

You should run 'sudo ldconfig' to finish the installation.

I guessed you set LD_LIBRARY_PATH to add /usr/local/lib in your environment setting. And it doesn't take effect when building project with maven/sbt and other build tools.
